featured-event.looks: An optional heading, then tall white event cards: a wide photo on top, a title, a one-line description, then up to four icon-and-label details (such as Duration, Location, For, Cost) and a button.
featured-event.use: Promoting one or a few specific events or trainings with their logistics.
featured-event.avoid: A schedule of many dates: use Training Sessions.

fields.title: Optional heading above the event cards.

fields.detail1Icon: Optional 32px icon for the detail, e.g. a clock for Duration.
fields.detail1Value: The value, e.g. '3 Days In-Person + Online'.
fields.ctaText: No arrow; the site adds one.
